blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Kayla Sanchez narrowly missed the podium in the Asian Games 2026 women’s 100m freestyle final on Tuesday at Tokyo Aquatics Centre. Sanchez ranked third after the first lap but finished fourth in 53.65 seconds, falling short of the bronze medal by 0.18 seconds behind China’s Yujie Cheng (53.47). Siobhan Haughey of Hong Kong won gold with a time of 52.45 seconds, followed by silver medalist Yiting Yu of China (53.21).
